an3.54:1.1: 55 athakho aññataro brāhmaṇaparibbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇaparibbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.54:1.2: sandiṭṭhiko dhammo sandiṭṭhiko dhammoti bho gotama vuccati
an3.54:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bho gotama sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
an3.54:2.1: ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attabyābādhāyapi ceteti parabyābādhāyapi ceteti ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti cetasikaṃpi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.54:2.2: rāge pahīne neva attabyābādhāyapi ceteti na parabyābādhāyapi ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.54:3.1: ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an3.54:3.2: rāge pahīne neva kāyena duccaritaṃ carati na vācāya duccaritaṃ carati na manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an3.54:4.1: ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti paratthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ubhayatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an3.54:4.2: rāge pahīne attatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti paratthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ubhayatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.54:4.3: evaṃpi kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti …
an3.54:5.2: mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attabyābādhāyapi ceteti parabyābādhāyapi ceteti ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti cetasikaṃpi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.54:5.3: mohe pahīne neva attabyābādhāyapi ceteti na parabyābādhāyapi ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.54:6.1: mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an3.54:6.2: mohe pahīne neva kāyena duccaritaṃ carati na vācāya duccaritaṃ carati na manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an3.54:7.1: mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti paratthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ubhayatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an3.54:7.2: mohe pahīne attatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti paratthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ubhayatthaṃpi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.54:7.3: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
an3.54:8.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
